units.locator: Chapter 3. LEGAL POSITION (STATUS) OF A MUNICIPAL SERVANT
units.text: Chapter 3. LEGAL POSITION (STATUS) OF A MUNICIPAL SERVANT
units.label: Chapter 3. LEGAL POSITION (STATUS) OF A MUNICIPAL SERVANT

units.locator: Article 10. Municipal Servant
units.text: Article 10. Municipal Servant
units.label: Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Municipal Servant
units.text: 1. A municipal servant is a citizen who performs the duties of a municipal service position according to the procedure established by municipal legal acts in accordance with federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in return for monetary remuneration paid from the local budget.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 10. Municipal Servant
units.text: 2. Persons performing technical support duties for local self-government bodies do not hold municipal service positions and are not municipal servants.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 10

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.label: Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 1. A municipal servant has the right to:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 1) familiarize themselves with documents establishing their rights and duties in the municipal service position held, criteria for evaluating the quality of performance of official duties, and conditions for promotion;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 2) be provided with the organizational and technical conditions necessary to perform official duties;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 3) receive remuneration and other payments in accordance with labor legislation, municipal service legislation and the employment agreement (contract);
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 4) rest, ensured through standard working (service) hours, days off and non-working public holidays, and annual paid leave;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 5) obtain, according to the established procedure, information and materials necessary to perform official duties, and submit proposals to improve the activities of the local self-government body;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 6) participate, on their own initiative, in a competition to fill a vacant municipal service position;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 7) receive additional professional education in accordance with a municipal legal act at the expense of the local budget;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 8) protection of their personal data;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 9) familiarize themselves with all materials in their personal file and with assessments of their professional activity and other documents before they are placed in that file, and have their written explanations added to the file;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 10) associate, including the right to establish trade unions, to protect their rights and their social, economic and professional interests;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 11) have individual labor disputes considered in accordance with labor legislation and protect their rights and legitimate interests in municipal service, including bringing violations of those rights and interests before a court;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 12) pension provision in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 11. Basic Rights of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 2. A municipal servant, other than a municipal servant holding the position of head of the local administration under a contract, may perform other paid work after giving prior written notification to the employer’s representative (employer), provided that this does not give rise to a conflict of interest and unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 11

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.label: Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 1. A municipal servant is obliged to:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 1) comply with and ensure the implementation of the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws, other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, constitutions (charters), laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, the municipality’s charter and other municipal legal acts;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 2) perform official duties in accordance with the job description;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 3) when performing official duties, respect human and civil rights, freedoms and legitimate interests regardless of race, ethnicity, language, attitude to religion or other circumstances, as well as the rights and legitimate interests of organizations;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 4) comply with the internal work rules, job description and procedures for handling official information established in the local self-government body;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 5) maintain the level of qualifications necessary for the proper performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 6) not disclose information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal laws, or information learned in connection with the performance of official duties, including information concerning citizens’ private lives and health or affecting their honor and dignity;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 7) safeguard state and municipal property, including property provided for the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 8) submit, according to the established procedure, information about themselves and their family members as provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 9) notify the employer’s representative (employer) in writing of the termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state that is a party to an international treaty of the Russian Federation under which a foreign citizen is entitled to serve in municipal service, on the day the municipal servant learns of this, but no later than five working days after the termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship (subjecthood) of such a foreign state that is a party to an international treaty of the Russian Federation under which a foreign citizen is entitled to serve in municipal service;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 9.1) notify the employer’s representative (employer) in writing of acquiring citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state or receiving a residence permit or another document confirming the citizen’s right to permanent residence in a foreign state, on the day the municipal servant learns of this, but no later than five working days after acquiring that citizenship (subjecthood) or receiving that residence permit or other document confirming the right to permanent residence in a foreign state;
units.label: Point 9.1 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 10) observe the restrictions, fulfill the obligations and not violate the prohibitions established by this Federal Law and other federal laws;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 11) notify the employer’s representative (employer) in writing of any personal interest in the performance of official duties that may lead to a conflict of interest, and take measures to prevent such a conflict;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 12) notify the employer’s representative (employer) in writing of changes of which the servant becomes aware to information contained in the questionnaire provided for by Article 15.2 of this Federal Law, except information changed by a decision of the employer’s representative (employer) (hereinafter referred to as information contained in the questionnaire).
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 12. Basic Duties of a Municipal Servant
units.text: 2. A municipal servant is not entitled to carry out an unlawful instruction given to them. Upon receiving from the relevant superior an instruction that the municipal servant considers unlawful, the servant must submit to the superior who gave the instruction a written explanation of its unlawfulness, identifying the provisions of federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, laws and other normative legal acts of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, and municipal legal acts that could be violated by carrying out the instruction. If the superior confirms the instruction in writing, the municipal servant is obliged to refuse to carry it out. If an unlawful instruction is carried out, both the municipal servant and the superior who gave the instruction are liable in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 12

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.label: Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 1. A citizen may not be admitted to municipal service, and a municipal servant may not remain in municipal service, in the event of:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 1) being declared legally incapable or of limited legal capacity by a court decision that has entered into legal force;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 2) being sentenced, by a court judgment that has entered into legal force, to a punishment that precludes the performance of duties in a municipal service position;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 3) refusal to undergo the procedure for obtaining clearance to information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal laws, if the duties of the municipal service position for which the citizen is applying or which the municipal servant holds involve the use of such information;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 4) having a disease that prevents entry into or performance of municipal service, as confirmed by a medical organization’s conclusion. The procedure for medical screening, the list of such diseases and the form of the medical organization’s conclusion are established by the federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 5) close kinship or affinity (parents, spouses, children, brothers and sisters, and also the brothers, sisters, parents and children of spouses and the spouses of children) with the head of the municipality who heads the local administration, if holding the municipal service position involves direct subordination or accountability to that official, or with a municipal servant, if holding the municipal service position involves direct subordination or accountability of one to the other;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 6) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state that is a party to an international treaty of the Russian Federation under which a foreign citizen is entitled to serve in municipal service;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 7) possession of citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state or a residence permit or other document confirming the citizen’s right to permanent residence in a foreign state, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 8) submission, upon entry into municipal service and/or during its performance, of forged documents and/or knowingly false information confirming compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements the violation of which precludes holding a municipal service position, or failure to submit documents and/or information demonstrating noncompliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements the violation of which precludes holding a municipal service position;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 9) failure to submit information provided for by this Federal Law, Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws, or submission of knowingly inaccurate or incomplete information upon entry into municipal service;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 9.1) failure to submit the information provided for by Article 15.1 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 9.1 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 10) being found, by a conclusion of the draft commission, not to have performed compulsory military service without lawful grounds for not doing so (except citizens who have performed military service under a contract), for 10 years from the expiry of the time limit for appealing that conclusion to the draft commission of the respective constituent entity of the Russian Federation; and, if that conclusion and/or the decision of the draft commission of the respective constituent entity of the Russian Federation on the citizen’s appeal against that conclusion was challenged in court, for 10 years from the entry into legal force of the court decision finding that the citizen’s rights were not violated when that conclusion and/or the decision of the draft commission of the respective constituent entity of the Russian Federation on the citizen’s appeal against that conclusion was adopted;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 11) acquisition of foreign agent status.
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 1.1. A citizen may not be appointed as head of the local administration under a contract, and a municipal servant may not hold that position under a contract, if they are closely related by kinship or affinity (parents, spouses, children, brothers and sisters, and also the brothers, sisters, parents and children of spouses and the spouses of children) to the head of the municipality.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 1.2. A citizen may not be appointed as chair, deputy chair or auditor of the municipality’s control and accounts body, and a municipal servant may not hold such positions, if they are closely related by kinship or affinity (parents, spouses, children, brothers and sisters, and also the brothers, sisters, parents and children of spouses and the spouses of children) to the chair of the municipality’s representative body, the head of the municipality, the head of the local administration, or heads of judicial or law enforcement bodies located within the respective municipality.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 2. A citizen may not be admitted to municipal service after reaching the age of 65, the maximum age established for holding a municipal service position.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 13. Restrictions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 3. To avoid conflicts of interest, a municipal servant who is the head of a local self-government body and a deputy head of such a body may not represent municipal servants’ interests in that body’s elected trade union body while holding their respective positions.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 13

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.label: Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 1. In connection with municipal service, a municipal servant is prohibited from:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 1) repealed with effect from 1 January 2015. — Federal Law No. 431-ФЗ of 22.12.2014;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 2) holding a municipal service position in the event of:
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: а) election or appointment to a state office of the Russian Federation or a state office of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, or appointment to a state service position;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: б) election or appointment to a municipal office;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: в) election to a paid elective position in a trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: 3) participating in the management of a commercial or nonprofit organization, except in the following cases:
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: а) participating without remuneration in the management of a political party or trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body, or participating in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real estate owners;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: б) participating without remuneration in the management of a nonprofit organization (other than participation in the management of a political party or trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body, or participation in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real estate owners), with permission from the employer’s representative obtained according to the procedure established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Prohibitions Related to Municipal Service
units.text: в) representing, without remuneration, the interests of the municipality in the council of municipalities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, other associations of municipalities, and their governing bodies;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 14
